core_obligations: Retain the exact sparsity, regularity, running-time and error hypotheses of the general magnification theorem.

difficulty_reason: A non-routine refined hash kernelization uses a short padded intermediate problem to turn tiny additive circuit improvements into strong lower bounds. Strong explicitness enables a parity-oracle MCSP variant, while perfect hashing handles deterministic obstructions; the matching threshold uses intersecting critical paths.
